symptom.observed: A V2 provider recovery action is automatically replaced after five seconds even when its provider action is still active; waiter order is nondeterministic and an admitted action has no explicit cancellation/drop transition.
symptom.expected: An admitted V2 recovery action remains exclusive until provider success, provider failure, terminal commit, or explicit health-neutral abandon. Waiters are FIFO and cancellation removes only the caller's ticket.

hypotheses.cause: V2 conflates the sustained five-second spacing deadline with an admitted action lifetime lease.
hypotheses.supporting_evidence: poll_admission clears admitted_generation solely when next_admission_at reaches zero, and the existing admitted_action_without_outcome test explicitly expects that behavior.
hypotheses.counter_evidence_or_gap: False only if an admitted generation remains blocked after next_admission_at and can be released by an explicit abandon operation.
hypotheses.verification_action: Replace the timed-expiry expectation with a red test that holds admission beyond its deadline, then explicitly abandons and verifies a full sustained floor.

hypotheses.cause: A HashSet waiter collection allows a later waiter to overtake the first waiter.
hypotheses.supporting_evidence: ProviderActionGateState.waiters has no stable order and poll_admission checks only membership.
hypotheses.counter_evidence_or_gap: False only if admission is explicitly restricted to the front ticket and cancellation preserves the remaining order.
hypotheses.verification_action: Add FIFO and middle-ticket cancellation red tests.

hypotheses.cause: The thin host has no admitted-action abort transition, so removing timed expiry would leave client-aborted actions permanently active.
hypotheses.supporting_evidence: Only cancel_wait exists and it removes a pre-admission waiter; admitted waiters are removed from the collection before the TS function returns.
hypotheses.counter_evidence_or_gap: False only if the admitted generation is explicitly abandoned on AbortSignal and the compare-by-generation operation is health-neutral.
hypotheses.verification_action: Add host mock tests for pre-admission cancel vs post-admission abandon and a native abandon contract test.
